5:3: This prophecy appears to have two fulfillments. The first fulfillment would be when God brings the people of Israel back to their land. The second and greater fulfillment is when the mother of the Messiah gives birth to him who is able to create the new, fully restored people of God, bringing together the remnant of Israel and all of his brothers redeemed from the rest of mankind.
